adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the code persists new attendee rows via `prisma.booking.update(... attendees.createMany ...)` (lines ~92-106) before calling `await eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking);` (line ~165). That calendar update is not wrapped in try/catch or a DB transaction/rollback mechanism, so if it throws (provider/API failure), the TRPC mutation will fail after the DB has already been modified, leaving DB state (guests added) potentially out of sync with the external calendar. The finding’s note about retries re-running against already-added guests is slightly overstated because `uniqueGuests` filters existing attendees and will throw BAD_REQUEST when none remain, but the core inconsistency/partial-failure defect is directly supported by the diff.
